subject: history
concept: Writing a short evidence-based historical argument citing specific sources
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to Literacy's argument-writing skills — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a short argument using a claim/evidence/source organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short paragraph making a historical claim supported by specific cited evidence

assessment.mastery_threshold: paragraph includes a clear claim and at least one specific, cited piece of evidence
misconception_flags: makes a historical claim with no specific supporting evidence or source reference

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
